name: 1sliquidity
description: **Foundry is a blazing fast, portable and modular toolkit for Ethereum application development written in Rust.**

scripts.tests: source .env && anvil --fork-url mainnet --port 8545 && npm run test:all:anvil
scripts.test:dexs: npm run test:uniswap-v2 && npm run test:sushiswap && npm run test:uniswap-v3
scripts.test:trade-placement: forge test --match-path script/processes/TradePlacement.s.sol --fork-url mainnet --via-ir && forge test --match-path script/TestSingleReserves.s.sol -vvvv --fork-url mainnet --via-ir
scripts.test:processes: npm run test:protocol && npm run test:trade-placement
scripts.# Combined Test Commands: # Commands to run multiple test suites
scripts.test:bear: npm run test:dexs && npm run test:processes && npm run test:reserves && npm run test:trade-cancel-test
scripts.test:all:anvil: npm run test:dexs-anvil && npm run test:processes-anvil && npm run test:reserves-anvil && npm run test:trade-cancel-test-anvil && npm run test:insta-anvil && npm run test:multi:anvil
scripts.test:quick: npm run test:uniswap-v2 && npm run test:trade-placement
scripts.# Anvil Fork Tests: # Tests running against local anvil fork
scripts.test:dexs-anvil: npm run test:uniswap-v2-anvil && npm run test:sushiswap-anvil && npm run test:uniswap-v3-anvil
scripts.test:processes-anvil: npm run test:protocol-anvil && npm run test:trade-placement-anvil
scripts.test:trade-placement-anvil: forge test --match-path script/processes/TradePlacement.s.sol -vvvv --fork-url mainnet --via-ir && forge test --match-path script/TestSingleReserves.s.sol -vvvv --fork-url mainnet --via-ir
scripts.# Deployment Scripts: # Scripts for deploying to different networks
scripts.deploy:mainnet:verify-all: npm run deploy:mainnet:verify && forge verify-contract $STREAM_DAEMON_ADDRESS src/StreamDaemon.sol:StreamDaemon --etherscan-api-key $ETHERSCAN_API_KEY --chain mainnet && forge verify-contract $EXECUTOR_ADDRESS src/Executor.sol:Executor --etherscan-api-key $ETHERSCAN_API_KEY --chain mainnet && forge verify-contract $REGISTRY_ADDRESS src/Registry.sol:Registry --etherscan-api-key $ETHERSCAN_API_KEY --chain mainnet
scripts.# DEX Integration Scripts: # Scripts for adding new DEXes to deployed protocol
